name: Pancakes
summary: **Pancakes** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:Cookie Fam Genetics]] following the 2017 collaboration between [[breeder:Seed Junky Genetics]] and Cookies. A cross of [[london-pound-cake|London Pound Cake]] and [[kush-mints|Kush Mints]], the original cut was never made available to home growers, though other seed banks later released their own versions.
